lens: J - Nordic design and materials advantage

ideas.name: Birch Board Care Kit
ideas.concept: Refillable food-safe board oil + beeswax paste with a birch applicator, sold as a refill subscription.
ideas.target_customer: Design-conscious SE/DK home cooks who own wooden boards.
ideas.problem_solved: Wooden boards crack and stain; people lack simple Nordic-styled care.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: web search and Firecrawl were unavailable (budget/credits exhausted); based on general knowledge of wood-care interest only.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Own formulation, tin/label design, refill system, bundle with partner board makers.

ideas.name: Ash Pot Lifter Trivet
ideas.concept: Folding ash-wood and cork trivet that doubles as a pot lifter, laser-cut flat pack.
ideas.target_customer: Nordic home cooks and gift buyers.
ideas.problem_solved: Hot pots on tables; bulky trivets.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no search possible this session; unverified assumption of demand for Nordic table accessories.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Registered design for the hinge geometry, local wood certification.

ideas.name: Linen Swedish Dishcloth Set
ideas.concept: Cellulose-cotton dishcloths with linen-trim, Nordic pattern collaborations, compostable packaging.
ideas.problem_solved: Replace disposable sponges and paper towels.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: category likely already crowded; no evidence gathered.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Exclusive artist prints and subscription pack.

ideas.name: Enamel Candle Dinner Set
ideas.concept: Small enamelled steel taper holders in muted Nordic colours using existing blanks.
ideas.problem_solved: Plastic or glass holders feel generic.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no search access; assumed demand from dining-table styling.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Colour palette and set design, limited seasonal runs.

ideas.name: Cork Pot Mat Roll
ideas.concept: Roll-up recycled cork and felt table mat, die-cut, no tooling beyond a cutting die.

ideas.name: Wool Felt Cast-Iron Handle Sleeve
ideas.concept: Wool felt grip covers fitted to common cast-iron skillet handles, sold with seasoning wax.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Fit-guide for popular pan models, bundled care wax formulation.
